target_customer: Nuclear facilities and other hazardous industrial sites (oil and gas, chemical, biological, space) that run recurring radiation surveys and inspections
problem: Mandatory manual surveys in hazardous areas expose workers and consume hours. Salem software turns existing or supplied robots into autonomous inspectors that produce auditable compliance records.
business_model: Software for robots plus turnkey robot deployments, contract based (pricing not found)
product_category: Autonomy software for industrial inspection robots

founders.name: Caleb Horan
prior_employers: Los Alamos National Laboratory (Plutonium Division, deployed multi robot teams; NRC Fellow)
education: PhD student in robotics, UT Austin

founders.name: Janak Panthi
founders.background_notes: About 6 years of industry experience deploying quadruped robots in nuclear facilities, per the YC page. Listed as Janak (Crasun) Panthi there.

competitors.name: Boston Dynamics Spot
competitors.what: Quadruped used for radiological inspection, for example at Sellafield and planned at Spain's Garona plant

competitors.name: ANYbotics ANYmal
competitors.what: Quadruped assessed for nuclear environments including Finland's Onkalo repository (vendor sourced)

competitors.name: DEEP Robotics
competitors.what: Quadruped inspection solution introduced at Leibstadt nuclear plant

technical_complexity.rationale: Autonomy with manipulation (opening doors, turning valves, handling instruments) in safety critical sites needs deterministic behavior and compliance grade records.

defensibility.rationale: Nuclear site trust and compliance records are slow to earn; hardware makers could add software, and the software is hardware agnostic.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Robot makers sell inspection robots into nuclear sites, but no copying of Salem's manipulation and compliance software is recorded.

market_need_then: Nuclear sites such as Sellafield already deploy robot dogs for inspection, and decommissioning and survey regulation create recurring manual work. The company reports active contract scoping in nuclear and oil and gas.

branding.domain_note: Uses salemroboticsinc.com, an exact name plus Inc suffix .com.

identity.logo: Logo icon and wordmark; design not described
identity.visual_style: Short bold headlines focused on safety

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN thread exists; a commenter said the name is confusing because Agility Robotics in Salem, Oregon ranks third in search for Salem Robotics

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive pairing but a place name shared with another robotics firm, per a Hacker News comment.

outcome_analysis: Salem Robotics is a two person Summer 2026 YC company with founders who deployed robots at Los Alamos, a strong fit for nuclear inspection. Funding amounts are conflicting on aggregators and unconfirmed, and no outcome exists yet. The main risks are slow nuclear sales cycles and robot makers moving into software.
notes: Funding figures conflict and are unverified: PitchBook 500K USD with GOOSE Capital and Y Combinator, VCBacked and FundedIQ 1.8M USD pre-seed, Dealroom 125K USD. A profile says the company site lists YC, Non Sibi Ventures and Goose Capital as investor partners but the company's own page fetched named only YC. None recorded as a round. One profile says the company is Austin based while YC lists San Francisco. Outcome search found no news.
